react_result.final_narrative_text: Three complementary pathway-analysis paradigms converge on arachidonic acid metabolism (KEGG:hsa00590) as the dominant affected pathway in this treatment-vs-control comparison. MetaboAnalystR PSEA ranked this KEGG pathway first with p = 7.5e-08, detecting five input metabolites as pathway members: arachidonic acid, leukotriene A4, 11,12,15-THETA, 15(S)-HETE, and 5(S)-HETE. Mummichog m/z-direct activity ranked the equivalent MUMM:arachidonic_acid_metabolism as the top hit (p = 0.00084) with a 13-compound overlap including all six eicosanoid input metabolites, plus multiple HPETE, EET, and DHET intermediates that co-occur in the network neighbourhood. RaMP multi-DB ORA returned a cluster of SMPDB drug-action pathways (NSAIDs including rofecoxib, aspirin, acetaminophen) all at FDR = 9.2e-18 with a fold-enrichment of 857, implicating the same six eicosanoids. CDP (cytidine diphosphate, KEGG:C00112) was flagged by Mummichog only in peripheral N-glycan biosynthesis and vitamin B5–CoA biosynthesis pathways at p = 0.054, consistent with a background off-target metabolite unrelated to the arachidonic acid cascade. The driver metabolite cluster is anchored by arachidonic acid (the canonical precursor) and includes five downstream eicosanoids: 5(S)-HETE and 15(S)-HETE (LOX products), 11,12,15-THETA (a trihydroxy triene downstream of 11,12-EET), leukotriene A4 (the 5-LOX branch point), and 15-deoxy-Δ12,14-prostaglandin J2 (a cyclopentenone PG produced non-enzymatically under oxidative stress, and a known PPARγ agonist). The co-occurrence of COX-branch prostaglandins with LOX-branch leukotrienes and HETEs is biologically consistent with a treatment that disrupts the entire membrane-phospholipid arachidonate release and enzymatic conversion network.

  "narrative_text": "Three independent pathway-analysis methods converge on arachidonic acid metabolism as the dominant affected pathway in this differential metabolomics study. Mummichog m/z-direct activity ranked MUMM:arachidonic_acid_metabolism as the top hit with p = 0.00134 and a 13-compound overlap including arachidonic acid, leukotriene A4, 15(S)-HETE, 5(S)-HETE, and 11,12,15-THETA. MetaboAnalystR PSEA identified KEGG:hsa00590 as the top KEGG pathway at p = 7.5e-08 with five input metabolites detected. RaMP multi-DB ORA returned the Rofecoxib Action Pathway (SMPDB:SMP00087) and multiple related SMPDB NSAID-action pathways at FDR = 9.2e-18 with a fold-enrichment of 857.8, implicating six eicosanoid input metabolites including 15-deoxy-d-12,14-PGJ2, arachidonic acid, and four downstream products. The driver metabolite cluster is anchored by arachidonic acid as the canonical upstream substrate, feeding into the 5-LOX branch (ALOX5 / leukotriene A4 / 5-HETE), the 15-LOX branch (15-HETE), and the CYP epoxygenase branch (11,12,15-THETA). CDP participates in N-glycan biosynthesis and vitamin B5-CoA biosynthesis pathways. final_react_result.final_narrative_text: Three independent pathway-analysis methods converge on arachidonic acid metabolism as the dominant affected pathway in this differential metabolomics study. Mummichog m/z-direct activity ranked MUMM:arachidonic_acid_metabolism as the top hit with p = 0.00134 and a 13-compound overlap including arachidonic acid, leukotriene A4, 15(S)-HETE, 5(S)-HETE, and 11,12,15-THETA. MetaboAnalystR PSEA identified KEGG:hsa00590 as the top KEGG pathway at p = 7.5e-08 with five input metabolites detected. RaMP multi-DB ORA returned the Rofecoxib Action Pathway (SMPDB:SMP00087) and multiple related SMPDB NSAID-action pathways at FDR = 9.2e-18 with a fold-enrichment of 857.8, implicating six eicosanoid input metabolites including 15-deoxy-d-12,14-PGJ2, arachidonic acid, and four downstream products. The driver metabolite cluster is anchored by arachidonic acid as the canonical upstream substrate, feeding into the 5-LOX branch (ALOX5 / leukotriene A4 / 5-HETE), the 15-LOX branch (15-HETE), and the CYP epoxygenase branch (11,12,15-THETA). CDP participates in N-glycan biosynthesis and vitamin B5-CoA biosynthesis pathways. The cross-paradigm consensus on arachidonic acid metabolism with six to thirteen detected eicosanoid derivatives reflects a coordinated shift in membrane-phospholipid-derived lipid mediators.
